gaps.explanation: Two parts. (1) Missing fund columns: p4 Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds prints Debt Service and Capital Projects columns with no schedule. Debt Service: Taxes - property 3,498,546 + Development contribution 323,002 + Highway allocation funds 93,615 + Investment and interest income 221,214 = 4,136,377 (printed Total revenues). Capital Projects: Taxes - property 4,435,651 + Taxes - city sales additional 1/2% 6,421,611 + Licenses, permits and fees 1,840,278 + Federal grants 286,553 + State Grants 562,500 + Other intergovernmental 90,996 + Highway allocation funds 766,048 + Investment and interest income 2,270,984 + Miscellaneous 1,596 = 16,676,217 (printed). 37,824,937 + 4,136,377 + 16,676,217 = 58,637,531. (2) Different basis, no fix: the pp8-12 budgetary comparison schedules are on the budgetary (cash) basis (reconciled to GAAP on p13): General p8 Total revenues 33,952,654 vs p4 General 53,795,248 (-19,842,594); ARPA p9 42,118 vs p4 3,665,234 (-3,623,116; p4 prints ARPA Federal grants 3,623,116); Keno Lottery p10 1,000,537 vs p4 1,044,278 (-43,741); Papillion Landing p11 2,494,566 vs p4 2,498,982 (-4,416); Papio Bay p12 335,062 vs p4 335,048 (+14). Sum -23,513,853; 58,637,531 + 23,513,853 = 82,151,384 = statement total. After the fix the schedule is 23,513,853 short, all budgetary-basis difference.
